nodes.label: Flask Backend (app.py)
nodes.rationale: Windows-primary with Linux/Pi fallback; hosts system/container/storage/security monitoring and the Claude tool-use chat loop.

nodes.label: Why this exists as a separate folder (test against real-like dependencies)
nodes.norm_label: why this exists as a separate folder (test against real-like dependencies)

nodes.label: Config Value Floor Hardening
nodes.rationale: ULTRON_LLM_MAX_TOKENS and ULTRON_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE originally had no floor; a misconfigured 0 or negative value would silently break chat. Both now clamp to a minimum of 1.

nodes.label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY Startup Script UX Trap
nodes.rationale: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was initially left active with a placeholder value unlike every other optional line (commented out by default), which would cause a confusing auth error instead of a clean 'not configured' message. Fixed to match the commented-out-by-default pattern.

nodes.label: Real Activity Log (SQLite-backed)
nodes.community_name: Financial and legal boundaries are explicit, not implied
nodes.rationale: Replaced a mock 'recent activity' feed; logs real backups/deploys/CVE scans with success/failure detail.

nodes.label: Cost Controls (caching, token budget, rate limit)
nodes.norm_label: cost controls (caching, token budget, rate limit)
nodes.rationale: Prompt caching with cache breakpoints, a real daily token budget with a verified hard stop (zero API calls once over budget), a request rate limiter, and full usage visibility via /api/chat/usage.

nodes.label: Discord backend_get Raw-Error-Text Bug
nodes.rationale: backend_get showed raw response text on errors instead of parsing the JSON error field, unlike backend_post and backend_get_csv; nearly every read-only command showed uglier errors than necessary. Found while building /usage; fixed to match the established correct pattern.

nodes.label: Discord Field Truncation Off-by-N Bug
nodes.rationale: value[:1000] + suffix (suffix 33 chars) totaled 1033, over Discord's hard 1024-char field limit. Fixed to compute the truncation point including the suffix length.

nodes.label: get_llm_usage Tool Registration Ordering Bug
nodes.rationale: get_llm_usage was defined after TOOL_DISPATCH referenced it, which would have raised NameError at import time; caught by the routine post-edit syntax check before it ever ran.

nodes.label: Coding Sub-Agent / Development Tab (git data)
nodes.rationale: Not in the original spec; emerged naturally, replacing the dashboard's mock Development tab with real git status/diff data.

nodes.label: Trade CSV Export (transactions + tax-lots)
nodes.rationale: Wired into the dashboard via fetch+Blob (a plain download link can't carry an auth header) and into the Discord bot as a real file attachment.

nodes.label: Discord Bot (bot.py)
nodes.rationale: Built as a thin HTTP client of the backend so no logic is duplicated.

nodes.label: Discord Bot Feature Parity
nodes.rationale: Every backend feature got a matching bot command as it was built: /repos, /diff, /trades, /portfolio, /export, /backup, /deploy with Confirm/Cancel buttons.

nodes.label: dev-tools/fake_pkgs/ (anthropic/discord/aiohttp fakes)
nodes.rationale: Scriptable fakes built to match real SDK shapes closely enough that code written against them needs no changes for the real thing.

nodes.label: _fifo_engine() Shared Trade Calculation
nodes.rationale: Refactor into a single shared function for per-disposal tax-lot detail, verified against the exact same hand-computed scenarios as before the refactor to prove zero behavioral drift.

nodes.label: get_repo_diff Chat Tool (parameterized)
nodes.rationale: First parameterized chat tool, taking a `repo` argument; required changing the core tool-dispatch mechanism to pass through arbitrary kwargs.

nodes.label: Home Lab Monitor & Command Router
nodes.rationale: Built first, as the backend's core monitoring layer.

nodes.label: Testing Philosophy (real services + scriptable fakes)
nodes.rationale: Verify against something that behaves like the real thing: real SQLite, real local git repos, a real protocol-compliant local MCP server, and end-to-end passes running actual dashboard JS via a Node vm sandbox against a real running backend.

nodes.label: Crypto/Trade Record & Tax Agent
nodes.rationale: Built as FIFO-based record-keeping, explicitly not advice; disclaimer embedded in every API response and exported CSV, not just shown once in the UI.

nodes.label: REMOTE-ACCESS.md (Tailscale setup)
nodes.rationale: Researched fresh; found Windows Firewall rules apply to all profiles by default when -Profile is omitted, and that autogroup:self doesn't cover Tailscale-tagged devices.

nodes.label: Real Action Endpoints (backup, deploy-container)
nodes.rationale: First things that mutate the host; deliberate two-step preview-then-confirm flow using a server-issued token, and deliberately excluded from chat's own initiative so Ultron never fakes compliance.

nodes.label: Ethical Hacking Agent (refused outright)
nodes.rationale: Never built; standing hard rule in the system prompt against exploit code or attack tooling, even under 'my own home lab' framing.

nodes.label: Explicit Safety Boundaries Maintained
nodes.rationale: No exploit tooling; no specific trading/investment advice; no chat-initiated host mutation; no trade-record writing via chat; no conversational bypass for MCP approval; every optional feature inert until configured.

nodes.label: Investment/Financial Predictive Agent (reinterpreted)
nodes.rationale: Refused as specified (trade proposals); reinterpreted into a legitimate factual record-keeping agent. Specific trading advice remains hard-refused, including about the user's own recorded trades.

nodes.label: Known, Deliberate Gaps
nodes.rationale: No stdio/local-subprocess MCP transport (HTTP only, smaller risk than spawning arbitrary local processes); no exchange API integration for trades; no CI integration for the Development tab; no raw WireGuard guide (Tailscale only); no automatic background retry for unreachable MCP servers.

nodes.label: MCP Empty Notification Response Bug
nodes.rationale: A 202 Accepted with no body is correct for notifications/initialized, but the client unconditionally tried to JSON-parse every response, raising a false error. Fixed by treating an empty body as {} rather than a parse failure.

nodes.label: MCP Response-Size Cap Applied at Wrong Layer
nodes.norm_label: mcp response-size cap applied at wrong layer
nodes.rationale: The safety cap was applied to raw HTTP bytes, truncating mid-JSON and corrupting structure. Fixed by separating a generous raw read ceiling (2MB backstop) from the user-facing content cap (4,000 chars), applied after successful JSON parsing, to extracted text only.

nodes.label: MCP (external tool/plugin) Support
nodes.rationale: Most security-sensitive feature built. Discovery and execution are separate: connecting a server discovers tools but grants nothing; only tools an operator names in a server's auto_approve list become callable. No in-conversation approval path, on purpose, since a model can't be trusted to resist a forged conversational 'yes' from prompt injection — the only path to execution is the operator's static config.
